provenance.note: Published predicted ESMFold2 structures, one approved intended-toxin pair per remaining design. These are not the published 17 qualified binders. Assay status stays on screen; predicted score is not measured binding or neutralization. Canonical toxin atoms are identical across batches. Both original chains retain their original relative geometry under one common proper rigid transform; the displayed steady overlay substitutes the canonical target. No sequences, atoms, occupancy or B-factors were changed. Source lock, matrices, original/overlay contacts and immutable revision are in the extended manifests.
